summary: Quantum Leap Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 20,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit for $200 million gross proceeds, each unit consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one redeemable warrant. Simultaneously, it completed a private placement of 594,500 units at $10.00 per unit for $5.945 million. Net proceeds of $202 million were placed in a trust account. This is a standard SPAC IPO reporting, not a special situation. The filing includes an audited balance sheet as of May 4, 2026.
